source_name: NJ Realty Transfer Fee schedule + amended mansion tax (rates reference)
verification_note: URL appeared in WebSearch listing (county page reproducing the statewide RTF schedule). The NJ Div. of Taxation RTF page itself did not appear literally in results.
difficulty_reason: Fixed statutory schedule.
notes: RTF is graduated (bracketed per-$500 rates, standard vs. senior/disabled/low-income vs. new-construction schedules; roughly ~1% effective at higher prices). Mansion tax amended effective 2025-07-10 (per Saul Ewing / Kulzer & DiPadova snippets): applied to ENTIRE price — 1% >$1M–$2M; 2% >$2M–$2.5M; 2.5% >$2.5M–$3M; 3% >$3M–$3.5M; 3.5% >$3.5M; obligation shifted from buyer to SELLER; parallel changes to the Controlling Interest Transfer Tax; grace period: contracts signed before 7/10/2025 and recorded before 11/15/2025 pay the old 1%. No separate county/city transfer tax in NJ.
